en: Abu az-Zubayr said: And I heard Jabir ibn Abdillah saying: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade clay jars (al-jarr), vessels pitched with tar (al-muzaffat), and hollowed stumps (an-naqir). And when the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) found nothing in which to prepare nabidh for him, it was prepared for him in a stone bowl.

And Muhammad ibn Rafi' narrated to me: Abd ar-Razzaq narrated to us: Ibn Jurayj informed us: Abu az-Zubayr informed me that he heard Ibn Umar saying: I heard the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbidding clay jars, gourds, and pitched vessels.

And Ahmad ibn Yunus narrated to us: Zuhayr narrated to us: Abu az-Zubayr narrated to us (H); and Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us: Abu Khaythamah informed us, from Abu az-Zubayr, from Jabir and Ibn Umar: that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade hollowed stumps, pitched vessels, and gourds.

And Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us: Yazid ibn Harun narrated to us: Abd al-Khaliq ibn Salamah informed us, who said: I heard Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab saying: I heard Abdallah ibn Umar saying by this pulpit—and he pointed to the pulpit of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace)—: The delegation of Abd al-Qays came to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) and asked him about drinks, so he forbade them gourds, hollowed stumps, and green earthen jars. So I said to him: "O Abu Muhammad, and pitched vessels?"—for we thought that he had forgotten it. He said: "I did not hear it that day from Abdallah ibn Umar, though he used to dislike it."
And Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar narrated it to us—both saying: Abu Dawud narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us, with this chain of narration.

Ubaydullah ibn Mu'adh narrated to us: my father narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us, from Amr ibn Murrah: Zadhan narrated to me, who said: I said to Ibn Umar: "Narrate to me what the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade of drinks in your dialect, and explain it to me in our dialect, for you have a dialect different from ours." So he said: "The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade al-hantam, which is the earthen jar; al-dubba', which is the gourd; al-muzaffat, which is the vessel smeared with pitch; and an-naqir, which is the trunk of a date-palm that is hollowed out and carved; and he commanded that nabidh be prepared in water skins."

Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us: Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us, from Jabalah, who said: I heard Ibn Umar narrating; he said: "The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade al-hantamah." I said: "What is al-hantamah?" He said: "The earthen jar."

Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar narrated to us—both saying: Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us, from Uqbah ibn Hurayth, who said: I heard Ibn Umar saying: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade clay jars, gourds, and pitched vessels, and said: "Prepare nabidh in water skins."

And Sa'id ibn Amr al-Ash'athi narrated to us: Abthar informed us, from ash-Shaybani, from Muharib ibn Dithar, from Ibn Umar, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), a similar narration. He said: And I believe he said: "and hollowed stumps."

Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Bashshar narrated to us—both saying: Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us, from Muharib ibn Dithar, who said: I heard Ibn Umar saying: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade al-hantam, gourds, and pitched vessels. He said: I heard him say it more than once.

Amr an-Naqid narrated to us: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah narrated to us, from Ibrahim ibn Maysarah, that he heard Tawus saying: I was sitting with Ibn Umar when a man came to him and said: "Did the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbid nabidh in clay jars, gourds, and pitched vessels?" He said: "Yes."

And Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to me: Bahz narrated to us: Wuhayb narrated to us: Abdallah ibn Tawus narrated to us, from his father, from Ibn Umar: that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade clay jars and gourds.

And Muhammad ibn Rafi' narrated to me: Abd ar-Razzaq narrated to us: Ibn Jurayj informed us: Ibn Tawus informed me, from his father, from Ibn Umar: that a man came to him and said: "Did the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbid that nabidh be prepared in clay jars and gourds?" He said: "Yes."

Yahya ibn Ayyub narrated to us: Ibn Ulayyah narrated to us: Sulayman at-Taymi narrated to us, from Tawus, who said: A man said to Ibn Umar: "Did the Prophet of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbid nabidh in clay jars?" He said: "Yes." Then Tawus said: "By Allah, I heard it from him."

And Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us: Hammad ibn Zayd informed us, from Thabit, who said: I said to Ibn Umar: "Did the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbid nabidh in clay jars?" He said: "They have claimed that." I said: "Did the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbid it?" He said: "They have claimed that."

And Qutaybah and Ibn Rumh narrated to us, from al-Layth ibn Sa'd (H); and Abu ar-Rabi' and Abu Kamil narrated to us—both saying: Hammad narrated to us (H); and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me: Isma'il narrated to us, all of them from Ayyub (H); and Ibn Numayr narrated to us: my father narrated to us: Ubaydullah narrated to us (H); and Ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us, from ath-Thaqafi, from Yahya ibn Sa'id (H); and Muhammad ibn Rafi' narrated to us: Ibn Abi Fudayk narrated to us: ad-Dahhak—meaning Ibn Uthman—informed us (H); and Harun al-Ayli narrated to me: Ibn Wahb informed us: Usamah informed me; all of them from Nafi', from Ibn Umar, a narration similar to the hadith of Malik, and they did not mention "in one of his military expeditions", except Malik and Usamah.

Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us, he said: I read to Malik, from Nafi', from Ibn Umar: that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) addressed the people in one of his military expeditions. Ibn Umar said: So I approached toward him, but he departed before I reached him, so I asked: "What did he say?" They said: "He forbade that nabidh be prepared in gourds and pitched vessels."

Shayban ibn Farrukh narrated to us: Jarir—meaning Ibn Hazim—narrated to us: Ya'la ibn Hakim narrated to us, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, who said: I asked Ibn Umar about nabidh in clay jars, and he said: "The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade nabidh in clay jars." So I went to Ibn Abbas and said: "Do you not hear what Ibn Umar says?" He said: "And what does he say?" I said: "He says: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade nabidh in clay jars." He said: "Ibn Umar spoke the truth; the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade nabidh in clay jars." So I said: "And what is nabidh in clay jars?" He said: "Everything made of baked clay."

And Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Surayj ibn Yunus narrated to us—and the wording is Abu Bakr's—both saying: Marwan ibn Mu'awiyah narrated to us, from Mansur ibn Hayyan, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, who said: I bear witness that Ibn Umar and Ibn Abbas testified that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade gourds, green earthen jars (hantam), pitched vessels, and hollowed stumps.

And Nasr ibn Ali al-Jahdhami narrated to us: my father narrated to me: al-Muthanna—meaning Ibn Sa'id—narrated to us, from Abu al-Mutawakkil, from Abu Sa'id, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade drinking from al-hantamah, gourds, and hollowed stumps.

And Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated it to us: Mu'adh ibn Hisham narrated to us: my father narrated to me, from Qatadah, with this chain of narration: that the Prophet of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade that nabidh be prepared... and he mentioned a similar narration.

Yahya ibn Ayyub narrated to us: Ibn Ulayyah narrated to us: Sa'id ibn Abi Arubah informed us, from Qatadah, from Abu Nadrah, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri: that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade gourds, green earthen jars, hollowed stumps, and pitched vessels.

Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us: Yazid ibn Zuray' informed us, from at-Taymi (H); and Yahya ibn Ayyub narrated to us: Ibn Ulayyah narrated to us: Sulayman at-Taymi informed us, from Abu Nadrah, from Abu Sa'id: that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade that nabidh be prepared in clay jars.

And Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated it to us: Abd al-Wahhab ath-Thaqafi informed us: Ishaq ibn Suwayd narrated to us, with this chain of narration, except that he said in place of al-muzaffat (tarred): al-muqayyar (pitched).

And Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim narrated to us: Ibn Ulayyah narrated to us: Ishaq ibn Suwayd narrated to us, from Mu'adhah, from A'ishah, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade gourds, green earthen jars, hollowed stumps, and pitched vessels.

Shayban ibn Farrukh narrated to us: al-Qasim—meaning Ibn al-Fadl—narrated to us: Thumamah ibn Hazn al-Qushayri narrated to us, who said: I met A'ishah and asked her about nabidh, and she narrated to me that the delegation of Abd al-Qays came to the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) and asked the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) about nabidh, so he forbade them to prepare nabidh in gourds, hollowed stumps, pitched vessels, and green earthen jars.

And Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to me: Yahya—and he is al-Qattan—narrated to us: Sufyan and Shu'bah narrated to us—both saying: Mansur, Sulayman, and Hammad narrated to us, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from A'ishah, from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), a similar narration.

And Sa'id ibn Amr al-Ash'athi narrated to us: Abthar informed us, from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from A'ishah: that the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade gourds and pitched vessels.

And Zuhayr ibn Harb and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us—both from Jarir; Zuhayr said: Jarir narrated to us, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, who said: I said to al-Aswad: "Did you ask the Mother of the Believers about what is disliked to prepare nabidh in?" He said: "Yes. I said: O Mother of the Believers, tell me about what the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade to prepare nabidh in. She said: He forbade us, the members of the household, to prepare nabidh in gourds and pitched vessels." He said: I said to him: "Did she not mention green earthen jars (hantam) and clay jars (jarr)?" He said: "I only narrate to you what I heard; should I narrate to you what I did not hear?"

Sa'id ibn Amr al-Ash'athi narrated to us: Abthar informed us (H); and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me: Jarir narrated to us (H); and Bishr ibn Khalid narrated to me: Muhammad—meaning Ibn Ja'far—informed us, from Shu'bah; all of them from al-A'mash, from Ibrahim at-Taymi, from al-Harith ibn Suwayd, from Ali, who said: "The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade that nabidh be prepared in gourds and pitched vessels." This is the hadith of Jarir. And in the hadith of Abthar and Shu'bah: "that the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade gourds and pitched vessels."
